headline: 今日新片冷淡，蜘蛛侠领跑热搜
headlineEn: Quiet release day, Spider-Man tops trends
summary: 2026年8月15日，今日无新片上映，本周共2部新片。热搜由《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》《别祝我好运》等领跑，观众聚焦话题新作与本周待映影片。
summaryEn: On Aug 15, 2026, no films opened today; 2 new movies arrive this week. Spider-Man: Brand New Day and Don't Wish Me Good Luck lead trending buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，市场静待本周2部新片
industryHighlights.en: No new releases today; market awaits 2 new films this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》持续霸榜，热度最高
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day keeps topping charts as hottest title.

industryHighlights.text: 《别祝我好运》今日搜索热度明显上升
industryHighlights.en: Don't Wish Me Good Luck sees a clear spike in searches today.

industryHighlights.text: 《摇滚夏令营3》《小黄人与大怪兽》《末日地堡》均受关注
industryHighlights.en: Camp Rock 3, Minions and the Big Monster, and Doom Bunker also draw attention.
